pkgmetadata.longdescription: A C/C++ speech-to-text inference library running diverse ASR/STT model families (Whisper, Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, and more) via GGUF models on the ggml runtime, with Metal, Vulkan, and CUDA backends plus a tinyBLAS-accelerated CPU path.

use.flag: Link a system BLAS for the host mel-spectrogram decoder
Use OpenMP for ggml's CPU threadpool
